title: Add or remove a class on a motor vehicle tradesperson certificate
summary: You can add or remove a class of repair work on your motor vehicle tradesperson certificate by visiting a Service NSW Centre or sending in a form by mail.
intro:
To add or remove a class of repair work on your motor vehicle tradesperson certificate you can either visit a Service NSW Centre or send the form by mail.

To find your tradesperson certificate number and details visit Verify NSW.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Motor Vehicle Tradesperson Certificate: Add a Class of Repair Work'
Photo ID, such as a driver licence
Details of your qualifications, including proof of completion of the relevant training course
For removing a class of repair work: A signed letter showing your certificate number and personal details, requesting removal of the class of repair work.

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and submit it:

faqs.q: How do I find my tradesperson certificate number and details?
faqs.a: You can visit Verify NSW to find your tradesperson certificate number and details.

faqs.q: How can I add or remove a class of repair work?
faqs.a: You can either visit a Service NSW Centre or send the form by mail.

faqs.q: What do I need to remove a class of repair work?
faqs.a: You will need a signed letter that clearly shows your certificate number and personal details, requesting removal of the class of repair work.
